integrity.computations: exact rational consistency tests, 648 cases; not a replacement for proof
integrity.proof_type: analytic infinite-index reduction and published self-decomposability criterion

scientific_limitations: Only the Bernoulli–Poisson–Lindley family with \(\theta>0\) and \(0<\alpha<1\) is classified; \(\alpha=0\) is used only as an endpoint illustration.
The all-index proof relies on the 1979 discrete canonical-sequence theorem; exact finite checks are only corroborative.
No claim is made for arbitrary stationary integer-valued autoregressions; one explicit batch-immigration construction is supplied.
Historical priority has not been independently certified and undiscovered literature may overlap.
title: A two-index thinning self-decomposability criterion for Bernoulli–Poisson–Lindley counts
